answer: Duplicate keys fail attestation, and each new identity costs a forfeitable bond plus a cooldown. Sybil resistance can work like a bonded wharf: each agent must stake a unique hardware-backed key and lock collateral prior to claiming identity. Peers verify one thread of provenance per key, so fake accounts drain capital without ever reaching the haven of trusted reputation. Attackers must pay real stake per identity and risk slashing, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0046 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
